content.title: Security & Data Governance
content.content:
SnapLogic provides enterprise-grade security controls required for aerospace manufacturing deployments:

**ENCRYPTION**

- **At rest**: AES-256 encryption for all stored data (pipeline definitions, credentials, logs)
- **In transit**: TLS 1.3 for all network communications (Manager ↔ Ground Plex, Ground Plex ↔ data sources)
- **Credential storage**: All connector credentials encrypted using AES-256 and stored locally in Ground Plex (never transmitted to SnapLogic cloud)

**AUTHENTICATION & ACCESS CONTROL**

- **SSO integration**: SAML 2.0 support for integration with {{customer_name}} identity provider (Active Directory, Okta, Azure AD)
- **Multi-factor authentication (MFA)**: Mandatory MFA enforcement for privileged accounts
- **Role-based access control (RBAC)**: Granular permissions at Org, Project Space, Project, and pipeline levels
- **API token authentication**: Secure API access for automated pipeline execution and integration with CI/CD tools

**AUDIT & COMPLIANCE**

- **Immutable audit logs**: Full trail of user actions, pipeline executions, and system events
- **Data lineage tracking**: End-to-end visibility of data flow from source to destination
- **Execution logs**: Detailed logs of every pipeline execution with success/failure status, error messages, and record counts
- **Compliance reporting**: Export audit logs and execution history for regulatory compliance review

**NETWORK SECURITY**

- **Outbound-only communication**: Ground Plex initiates all connections to Manager (no inbound firewall rules required)
- **IP whitelisting**: Restrict Ground Plex communication to SnapLogic Manager IP ranges
- **VPN/Private Link support**: Option to route Manager ↔ Ground Plex traffic over VPN or AWS PrivateLink for additional network isolation

**DATA GOVERNANCE**

- **Data masking**: Built-in Snaps for PII masking, tokenization, and anonymization
- **Data quality validation**: Schema validation, data type checking, null/duplicate detection
- **Error handling**: Configurable error routing, retry policies, and alerting for data quality issues
- **Metadata tagging**: Tag pipelines and data assets with business glossary terms, data classification, and ownership information
